sections.head: Pair load tests with functional runs

items.a: Performance testing measures how fast and stable an application stays under expected and peak traffic. Load, stress, spike and soak tests are common types.

items.q: Can I use my existing JMeter scripts?
items.a: Yes. TestMu AI runs existing JMeter .jmx plans and Gatling simulations on managed cloud load generators.

items.q: What is the difference between load testing and performance testing?
items.a: Load testing is one type of performance testing. It checks behaviour at a set number of users. Performance testing also covers stress, spike and soak tests.
Response time percentiles, throughput, error rates and per-sampler results, with pass or fail thresholds you define.

items.q: How much does cloud load testing cost on TestMu AI?
items.a: There is a free tier for API and browser load tests. Paid performance testing starts at $79 per month; Pro is $349 per month.
